summary: Kornit Digital Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results via press release and slide presentation. The filing details revenues of $55.3 million, above guidance, with ARR growth of 79% year-over-year to $33.8 million, and positive adjusted EBITDA margin. CEO Ronen Samuel comments on business transformation and screen market penetration, with ~60% of systems sold to traditional screen printers. This is a routine earnings disclosure, incorporating financials by reference into Form S-8 registration statements. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is present; the filing solely provides operational and financial updates, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
